title: Methods and apparatuses for Li extraction and generation of high purity lithium hydroxide
abstract: User-provided USPTO Patent Public Search excerpt describes a lithium-ion-selective ceramic membrane for dry transfer of lithium ions from a brine or recycling feed to a lithium hydroxide solution, with a laminated cation-exchange layer. The excerpt mentions potential hydrogen and chlorine gaseous coproducts. Patent disclosures are not independent evidence of operation, industrial performance, ownership by GPT-Doug, or safety.
